'''2008 Worlds Team Steve Harpster DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title AOBS. Crossed-out lines replaced with handwritten finals.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
